headline: Oil rises as attacks in Hormuz continue
summary: WTI crude rose 2.35%, or 1.88 dollars, as attacks continued in the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for Gulf oil exports.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and energy supply expectations.
why_moved: Continuing attacks in the Strait of Hormuz raised concerns about oil supply, pushing WTI crude up 2.35%.
original_headline: Petróleo al alza mientras siguen los ataques en Ormuz
